name: Katagiri Kasumi
source:
A girl who lacks sexual knowledge, yet is very gentle in her daily life. She is a quiet-looking young lady with a bob cut tucked in at the shoulders. She seems to be childhood friends with Yuri Fujisaki, and they do everything together. Her feelings for Yuri may even go beyond the realm of friends. She is unable to understand her own body, which might be fun to teach...

[Translated from in-game Description]
